**Finding: IP — Compliant (no redline).**

The IP direction favours us throughout:

- **Ownership/assignment (13.1, p0197–p0198):** IBM owns and MSL assigns all IP in the hardware, software, design and documentation of all Products, plus MSL inventions on Products and on IBM processes/systems. Outright ownership exceeds both the fallback licence and the preferred licence-back construct.
- **Vendor generic tools (p1088):** MSL owns commonly used production/integration tooling — expressly permitted.
- **Vendor licence in our information (13.3(a), p0208):** limited to confidential information "necessary to manufacture Products solely for IBM", with any other licence requiring a separate signed IBM agreement; materials must be returned on termination (p0130).
- **No joint ownership, no assignment of IBM IP or data to MSL** — no walk-away trigger.

Noted but not flagged: no express MSL pre-existing-IP retention sentence (a vendor-side omission), no standalone Customer Data ownership sentence, and 24.1(a)'s "MSL conveys to IBM no software title or license" statement, which is confined to the I/T systems context and overridden for delivered Products by 13.1. The AECI residuals clause sits under the confidentiality rule.
